settings.name: LOADBALANCER_HEALTHCHECK_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Shared dict size (datastore for all healthchecks).

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_ZONE_SIZE
settings.description: Shared memory zone size for upstreams with dynamic resolution (all resolved upstreams share one zone).

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_UPSTREAM_NAME
settings.description: Name of the upstream (used in REVERSE_PROXY_HOST).

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_UPSTREAM_SERVERS
settings.description: List of servers/IPs in the server group.

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_UPSTREAM_KEEPALIVE
settings.description: Number of keepalive connections to cache per worker.

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_HEALTHCHECK_FALL
settings.description: Number of failed healthchecks before marking the server as down.

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_HEALTHCHECK_RISE
settings.description: Number of successful healthchecks before marking the server as up.

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_HEALTHCHECK_VALID_STATUSES
settings.description: HTTP status considered valid in healthchecks.

settings.name: LOADBALANCER_HEALTHCHECK_HOST
settings.description: Host header for healthchecks (useful for HTTPS).
